notes.title: WitchGhost Demo
notes.content:
Introducing WitchGhost

I am thrilled to announce the release of the WitchGhost Demo!

The demo contains the first chapter of the game (levels 1 to 5) set in the Haunted Witcheye Woods and the first level of Chapter 2 set in the Wicked West. Check out the list below for planned upcoming features to be added to the demo

- More enemy types
- More varied scenery
- NPC side quests and puzzles to solve
- Background music for each world

I sincerely hope you enjoy the WitchGhost Demo and I look forward to hearing your feedback.

Have a scary good time!
Scot @ personalError
